title: excellent app with great features
body: i love everything about this app! it is extremely easy to maneuver and offers a variety of layout options. the best part is being able to add an unlimited amount of habits without being forced to pay a premium subscription fee, and there are absolutely no ads, which make the overall experience excellent. i would have a 5 star rating if a few small changes could be made like emoji/covers maybe an option to use our phone’s default emojis, more colours as well because they are currently limited and an option to add a description or short text for each habit. other than that i highly recommend it! 🤍
author: 𝓒. 🪷🥢
